## What's New

- Username/password signup and login using Neon Managed Auth, with unique case-insensitive usernames and live availability checks.
- Account-isolated profiles, settings, addons, integrations, watchlists, watched history, playback progress, remembered sources/subtitles and custom images.
- Encrypted cloud snapshots with revision conflict protection, Sync Now, Restore Cloud Copy, Keep This TV's Copy and Sign Out controls.
- One-time import of existing local profiles after signing in. Original local data is retained.
- Interrupted cloud restores can recover using an encrypted restore journal; account switches restart account-bound processes and caches.
- Non-4K profile onboarding removes 4K/UHD from allowed qualities.
- Unified seeking/thumbnail setting renamed Seek Interval.
- One Auto-Skip Countdown controls intro and outro/next-episode countdowns: Off, 5 seconds or 10 seconds.

## Installation And Important Limits

- Optimized, non-debug **32-bit ARM (`armeabi-v7a`)** APK; Android 8.0 or newer; package `com.saab.tv`, version code 58.
- Uses the existing release signing certificate: install over the previous matching signed release without uninstalling. Sign in and select **Import Existing Profiles** to retain previous local profiles.
- Passwords require at least **8 characters**, including uppercase, lowercase, number and special character, to meet the authentication provider's minimum.
- Email recovery and password changes are not available yet. Preserve your password; losing it can make encrypted backups unrecoverable.
- Cloud sync uses whole-account snapshots with explicit conflict resolution, not automatic concurrent-device merging. Media, thumbnail files and diagnostic logs are not uploaded.

## Verification

- Local verification: 134 unit tests passed; release lint reported zero errors; APK signing, package and ABI checks passed.
- Live authentication, username availability, cloud save/read, revision conflicts, cross-account read isolation and anonymous access denial were tested. Temporary QA accounts and snapshots were removed.
- Android instrumentation tests compile but were not run because no TV/emulator was connected. Remote navigation, legacy import, multi-TV restore and account restart still need physical-TV validation.
- GitHub Actions runs unit tests and release lint again before publishing the signed APK and SHA-256 checksum.
